The Secret Sauce

What Is
Jollof Factory?

It's not just sauce. It's a versatile, tomato-free, pepper-based powerhouse. Slow-cooked aromatics, ginger, garlic, and proprietary spices in a jar.

  • Smoky & Savory
  • Gentle on digestion (No Tomato!)
  • Fridge & Freezer Friendly

Why It Slaps

(And why you need it in your pantry right now)

Tomato-Free

A pepper-based powerhouse without the acidity. Pure flavor.

Versatile

Rice, pasta, pizza, stews. If you can cook it, you can Jollof it.

10-Min Magic

Deep simmered taste in minutes. Cheating? Maybe. Delicious? Yes.

Consistent

Chef-quality flavor profiles every single time. No guesswork.

THE PROCESS

3 Steps to Glory

1

Heat It

Warm up oil in your pan. Get it sizzling.

2

Mix It

Toss in protein/veggies & a big scoop of Base.

3

Eat It

Simmer 10 mins. Serve. Take all the credit.
